description: Test class for PerformanceReviewDao, covering CRUD operations, exception handling, and review status retrieval within the Performance plugin of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for performance review data access object, testing various CRUD, status, and exception scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets up DAO instance, and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of performance review list with filters.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewCount
methods.description: Tests counting of performance reviews based on filters.

methods.name: testGetEditableReviewById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of editable review by ID, including cases of non-existing IDs.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorRecord
methods.description: Tests presence or absence of supervisor records for an employee.

methods.name: testCreateReviewWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures transaction exceptions are properly thrown during review creation.

methods.name: testUpdateReviewWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures transaction exceptions are properly thrown during review updates.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceSelfReviewStatus
methods.description: Validates status strings returned based on reviewer status.

methods.name: testUpdateReviewerComment
methods.description: Checks that reviewer comments can be updated and persisted correctly.
